budget_rule: floor(18.75*joint physical mu); no carry or realized-expenditure reallocation; equal shares take integer floor with deterministic remainder in canonical region order
menu: 21 options: P0; full common envelope to one of four regions with one of four instruments; equal envelope shares using same one of four instruments
markets: four government policy regions; demand and supply matched only within original province code and sampled households; no external pool or invented counterparty
parcel_rule: physical area_e conserved; split verified_right and restricted remainder by 2010 grain and cash shares of annual total sowing, residual idle/other; divide each bucket into equal lots at most 4 mu; no inferred title beyond verified right; no inherited fictional lease
price_and_technology: unchanged 7a crop yields, prices, costs and peak days per mu; common land quality 1, no parcel yields inferred; 1 production season per year
labor_and_income: F1 worker count and 120/180/176 annual farming-day group proxy; quarter annual window for competing farm and wage time; three quarters of archived wage receipt are outside the decision window and are credited at settlement; no borrowing and no fabricated hired labor
settlement: F1 opening balance minus segregated reserve; use F1 household consumption proxy; retain 7a shocks, rent ask and cost constants; fixed 2-year model leases to exercise in-force contracts. No inherited F1 behavior coefficients re-estimated.
matching: 7a release, search failures, ascending rent floor, descending bids and midpoint rent; rank by yuan/mu; bidder capacity reserves upper bid, fees, unit-specific production inputs and peak days through allocation; moneys and area balanced
production_allocation: retain the 7a feasible grain, cash and idle options and foregone wage comparison; exact small variable lots, deterministic feasible greedy improvement for larger portfolios
observation: remaining of eight decisions, four lagged per-region grain indicators above 60% of 7a full grain yield times area, and fixed common limit; period one public output from NFPS prod_food; no other private state
update: finite-horizon fitted Q, undiscounted sum of kilos; myopic same openings/menu, current kilos only; enumerate every action with shared region shocks; no evaluation exploration; P0 fallback, developer P0 continuation for unseen states
withdrawal: branch by same seed/history and frozen policy after year 6; compare forced P0 in years 7–8 versus its own continuing allocation and P0 all years; this interruption is not part of training reward
evaluation: all fixed 21 reported; primary fixed selected on development only; Q and myopic compared per region and joint on full paired seeds; unweighted grain, fiscal actuals, and withdrawal reported separately; two primary comparisons x three main endpoints use Bonferroni t CIs; secondary intervals descriptive
evidence_limit: mechanism model using an archived observed cohort; not a representative national policy evaluation; independent shocks are not an independent household panel
